title:
Why your fee
*isn't your neighbour's*

lines.say: You're buying a condo. Your maintenance fee is higher than your neighbour's. Why?
Fees are shared by share value, which depends on the size of your unit.
Bigger units pay more. Penthouses pay the most.
Part goes to running costs. Part goes to the sinking fund, for big repairs later.
Fund too low when the lifts need replacing? Owners can be asked for a special levy, also by share value.
Before you buy, ask for the latest financial statements and the sinking fund balance.
Save this before your next viewing.

caption:
Buying a condo and your maintenance fee is higher than your neighbour's? 🏢

Fees are shared by share value, which depends on unit size. Bigger units pay more. Part goes to running costs, part to the sinking fund for big repairs. Fund too low when the lifts need replacing? Owners can be asked for a special levy, also by share value.

Before you buy, ask for the latest financial statements and the sinking fund balance.
